(Capacity: 4,200) |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2020-21 Big West men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Long Beach State men's basketball team''' represented [[California State University, Long Beach]], in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Beach were led by 14th-year head coach [[Dan Monson]] and played their home game at the [[Walter Pyramid]] in [[Long Beach, California]] as a member of the [[Big West Conference]]. In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], they finished the season 6–12, 4–8 in Big West play to finish in ninth place. They defeated [[2020–21 Cal State Northridge Matadors men's basketball team|Cal State Northridge]] in the first round of the [[2021 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|Big West tournament]] before losing to [[2020–21 UC Santa Barbara Gauchos men's basketball team|UC Santa Barbara]] in the quarterfinals. == Previous season == [[2019–20 Long Beach State Beach men's basketball team|Long Beach State]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 11–21, 6–10 in Big West play to finish in a tie for seventh place. The [[2020 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|Big West tournament]] was canceled due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]] effectively ending the
